output.summary: A bulbous flowering plant native to southwestern Europe, northwestern Africa, Madeira and the Canary Islands, three-cornered garlic has triangular flower stalks and narrow leaves that smell strongly of onion when crushed. Every part, from bulb to flower, is edible fresh or cooked and can be used like spring onions or wild onions.
